label: Skipped
name: skipped
hint: Non-empty when nothing happened: already posted for this week / no activity has enough recent logs / challenge not found / this week's challenges have ended / test post is full / no open challenge post whose week is over / nobody accepted a goal.

label: Mode
name: mode
hint: post (the Monday run) | recap (the end-of-week run) | click (someone pressed Accept).

label: Testing
name: testing
hint: True for a test post (input `testing` = yes) or a press on one: nothing was written to the data table.

toggle_field.label: Testing
toggle_field.name: testing
toggle_field.hint: True for a test post (input `testing` = yes) or a press on one: nothing was written to the data table.

label: Preview
name: preview
hint: [post] True when nothing was posted (skip_post = yes, or no Slack token / channel): the messages are in preview_json.

toggle_field.label: Preview
toggle_field.name: preview
toggle_field.hint: [post] True when nothing was posted (skip_post = yes, or no Slack token / channel): the messages are in preview_json.

label: Week
name: week
hint: The Monday of the week the goals are for, YYYY-MM-DD.

label: Level
name: level
hint: [post] The level input: the smallest goal any challenge may be set at. Each challenge's own size in levels is in challenges[].level.

label: Post ID
name: post_id
hint: The id of the post (also the id of its row and what its buttons carry). Empty for a test post.

label: Message ts
name: message_ts
hint: [post] ts of the channel message. [recap] ts of the results post.

label: Reply ts
name: reply_ts
hint: [post] ts of each reply in its thread, in order. A reply that did not go is left out and reported in warnings.

label: Challenges
name: challenges
hint: [post] The goals, busiest activity first -- and the figures behind each, so a level can be judged before it is posted.

properties.label: Activity
properties.name: activity
properties.hint: pushup, plank, step, yoga ... or a game's: iadd_plays, iadd_score ...

properties.label: Text
properties.name: text
properties.hint: The goal as the team reads it: 100 pushups, 10 min of plank. With personal on, the category instead (Pushups, Plank): no figure is posted.

properties.label: Target
properties.name: target
properties.hint: The goal in the unit the table stores: reps, minutes, seconds of plank, steps. With personal on this is the team reference, which is not shown anywhere.

properties.label: People
properties.name: people
properties.hint: People who logged this activity in the last 4 finished weeks (a game: who finished a game in the last 28 days).

properties.label: Typical week
properties.name: typical_week
properties.hint: What a typical active person logs in a week of it (a game: games a week for _plays, the typical best score for _score).

properties.label: Best week
properties.name: best_week
properties.hint: The biggest week anyone has had (a game: the top pace, or the top score). No challenge reaches it.

properties.label: Capped
properties.name: capped
properties.hint: True when this level asked for more than 90% of the best week and was held there.

toggle_field.label: Capped
toggle_field.name: capped
toggle_field.hint: True when this level asked for more than 90% of the best week and was held there.

properties.label: Loose rows
properties.name: loose_rows
properties.hint: Rows whose total and heatmap_dates differ in length, so only their last 4 weeks were used.

properties.label: Ladder
properties.name: ladder
properties.hint: The goal at levels 1 to 5, for choosing a level.

properties.label: Limit
properties.name: limit
properties.hint: The most a goal for this category may ever ask in a week, in the same unit as target (a workout's is 6 hours, a plank's 1 hour). However far someone climbs, no target, size on offer or level goes past it.

properties.label: Level
properties.name: level
properties.hint: How big this goal is in levels: the highest level whose figure does not pass it. For reading only: with adaptive on a goal moves along round figures between the level input's and level 3's, not by whole levels.

properties.label: Last target
properties.name: last_target
properties.hint: Last week's goal for this challenge, in the same unit as target. 0 when it was not set last week (or adaptive is off).

properties.label: Last taken
properties.name: last_taken
properties.hint: People who took this challenge on last week.

properties.label: Last cleared
properties.name: last_cleared
properties.hint: Of those, how many did at least the goal that was posted (whatever size they picked for themselves). These two figures decide how far the goal goes: 3 in 4 or more takes two steps up, a third or fewer takes one step back, and anything else, or fewer than 2 takers, the plain one step up.

properties.label: Move
properties.name: move
properties.hint: How the goal moved since last week: up | down | same. Empty when there is no goal from last week to compare with.

properties.label: Level ups
properties.name: level_ups
properties.hint: The bigger goals on offer to whoever accepts it, as its Stretch and Summit buttons will show them. Empty when no bigger goal fits under the best week anyone has had.

properties.label: Why
properties.name: why
properties.hint: One line on why the goal is what it is this week: how last week went, and whether it stepped up, eased, or stayed because it is already at the top or bottom of its range.

label: Left out
name: left_out
hint: [post] Activities that have rows but got no goal, and why.

label: Personal
name: personal
hint: [post] True when the post shows categories and each person's target is worked out for them (input `personal`). Then challenges[].text is the category and challenges[].target the team reference, which is not shown.

toggle_field.label: Personal
toggle_field.name: personal
toggle_field.hint: [post] True when the post shows categories and each person's target is worked out for them (input `personal`). Then challenges[].text is the category and challenges[].target the team reference, which is not shown.

label: Adapted from
name: adapted_from
hint: [post] The Monday of the earlier post this week's goals were set from. Empty when none was found (the run says why in warnings), or when adaptive is off.

label: Closed previous
name: closed_previous
hint: [post] Earlier posts whose buttons were taken off (or, on a forced repost, whose messages were deleted). [recap] 1 when the week was closed.

label: Rows read
name: rows_read
hint: [post] Activity rows read.

label: Rows loose
name: rows_loose
hint: [post] Rows behind the goals whose total and heatmap_dates differ in length (written before the two were kept in step).

label: Rows written
name: rows_written
hint: Rows written to the data table. Always 0 in test mode.

label: User ID
name: user_id
hint: [press] Who pressed.

label: User name
name: user_name
hint: [press] Their name, as shown on the post.

label: Activity
name: activity
hint: [press] The challenge whose button was pressed: an activity (pushup) or a game's (iadd_plays, iadd_score).

label: Accepted
name: accepted
hint: [press] People who have now accepted that goal.

label: Already
name: already
hint: [press] True when this person had already accepted it: nothing was added.

toggle_field.label: Already
toggle_field.name: already
toggle_field.hint: [press] True when this person had already accepted it: nothing was added.

label: Tracking
name: tracking
hint: [press] What happened to the goal on the person's row of the activity, where spotter finds it: tracked | pending (they have never logged the activity, so their first log picks it up) | blocked (the column holds something that is not ours; left alone) | unwritten | unreadable | none.

label: Recap
name: recap
hint: [recap] Each goal somebody took on: how many accepted and how many cleared it.

properties.label: Text
properties.name: text
properties.hint: The goal as the team read it: 100 pushups.

properties.label: Names
properties.name: names
properties.hint: First names of those who cleared it. Anyone who has opted out is counted, never named.

label: Progress shown
name: progress_shown
hint: Click on Show my progress: how many of the presser's weekly goals were shown to them.

label: Picked
name: picked
hint: Click on a Steady / Stretch / Summit button: the goal the person set for themselves, as the team reads it (150 pushups). Empty otherwise.

label: Picked goal
name: picked_goal
hint: The same goal in the unit the table stores (reps, minutes, seconds of plank, steps). 0 when nobody picked a size.

label: Post style
name: post_style
hint: Monday run: the post_style used (1-3).

label: Preview json
name: preview_json
hint: With skip_post = yes: a JSON list of the messages ({where, text, blocks}), channel message first. Paste a "blocks" list into Slack's Block Kit Builder to look at it.
